Body.Content:
TypeScript is a popular open source programming language that transpiles to JavaScript, adding supports for typings and other language features. Development teams enjoy working with TypeScript to build front-end and/or Node.js apps at scale, with less bugs.

Today, TypeScript 4 reaches general availability, containing new language features and improvements.

Learn more
